instructions: Judge only what you see. Answer every question. For pairs, choose exactly one answer from answer_menu and give a one-sentence rationale describing the visual evidence and a confidence of low, medium or high. For the sequence question, give the number of distinct scenes and the panel numbers after which each change occurs.

answer_menu.NEAR_DUPLICATE: Same photograph, possibly re-encoded, resized, cropped or colour-shifted.
answer_menu.POSSIBLE_SEQUENCE_RELATION: Different photographs or frames of the same physical fruit(s) and the same scene or setup.

do_not_use.EXACT_DUPLICATE: Byte identity is established by hash, never by eye. Do not use.
do_not_use.CONFIRMED_SEQUENCE_RELATION: Requires external records, not visual judgement. Do not use.
